items: Areas are bigger (about half as wide again, 168 m across) and fewer (14 by 14), so the forest is about the same size but each area has more room

Every area has room to fight round its middle and its soundsystem: mostly open ground, the woods thickening gradually out to the area's normal forest, with lone trees and bushes thinning into the clearing
Berry bushes and berries are as thick on the ground as before in the bigger areas
The ring round a party animal is split into one segment for each berry it needs; each berry it eats lights a segment, and the ones still to eat show pale
